vaultRules: Assign exactly one category by the reader's main reason for using the resource; its file host and whether it has a website are link details, not categories.
Choose Sample Vaults & Templates first when the main value is a reusable starter vault, template, example system, or note structure—even if it is about a specific subject.
Choose Curated Directories when the entry primarily indexes links to other sites or media rather than presenting its own knowledge collection.
Choose Food & Cooking for cooking-focused collections and Programming & Software for software, computing, or developer resources.

Choose Publishing & Personal Sites for an author's own public notes, digital garden, or personal site; choose Knowledge & Reference for other wikis, documentation, reference works, and research collections.

vaults.name: Curated Directories
vaults.scope: Link collections and directories whose main value is helping readers find external sites or media.

vaults.name: Food & Cooking
vaults.scope: Recipe collections, cookbooks, meal-planning material, and other cooking-focused resources.

vaults.name: Knowledge & Reference
vaults.scope: Subject knowledge bases, wikis, documentation, reference works, and research collections, except resources whose primary purpose fits a more specific subject or format category.

vaults.name: Programming & Software
vaults.scope: Programming and computer-science learning, software documentation, developer tools, and computing-focused vaults.

vaults.name: Publishing & Personal Sites
vaults.scope: Personal websites, digital gardens, and published vaults whose main purpose is sharing the author's own notes or work, not providing a reusable template for others.

vaults.name: Sample Vaults & Templates
vaults.scope: Reusable starter vaults, templates, example systems, and note structures intended to be copied or adapted.

resources.name: Cheat Sheets and Miscellaneous
resources.scope: Small standalone reference aids, study materials, or useful resources that do not form a larger subject collection.

resources.name: Dictionaries and Language Resources
resources.scope: Dictionaries, word lists, and other language-reference resources.

resources.name: Encyclopedia Resources
resources.scope: Large general-knowledge collections, encyclopedias, and offline knowledge libraries.
